card.name: Error! hyperlink placeholder and surname pieces
card.fires_on: The exclamation mark after "Error" in broken cross-reference text ("Error! Hyperlink reference not valid"). Also partway through unusual surnames in author names, such as Hojilla-Evangelista or Falavigna.

modes.label: Broken cross-reference
modes.description: The "!" right after "Error" in a label's leftover hyperlink error message.

modes.label: Inside author surnames
modes.description: A short piece in the middle of a foreign or hyphenated surname in a citation or byline.
modes.example: Chemist Mila Hojilla-E<<v>>angelista tests the breaking point of plywood

card.writes: The promoted tokens (rey, grey, ility) and suppressed Chinese tokens show no clear link, so the output effect is weak.
card.plain: It marks the "Error!" in broken cross-references in drug labels and the middle of unusual author surnames.
